description: Imputed alcohol (alcohol_im) by fatal status, police-reported vs imputed records
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Weighted P(alcohol_im = yes) among fatal and non-fatal training crashes, separately where police-reported alcohol is known and where it was imputed
